brief:
The healthcare system in Gaza has deteriorated so severely that medical services are now inaccessible to the most vulnerable residents, particularly those living in displacement camps, according to Al Jazeera English. The right to health, once a basic provision, has effectively become a privilege available only to those with resources or proximity to functioning facilities.

Displacement camps across Gaza lack adequate medical infrastructure to serve their populations. Those sheltering in these makeshift settlements face compounded barriers to treatment as the territory's already devastated healthcare network continues to fail, leaving the poorest and most displaced without reliable access to care.
dek: The devastated healthcare system cannot reach Gaza’s most vulnerable – those who live in displacement camps.
title: Gaza's collapsed healthcare system abandons displaced populations
